properties.Name: Alice Johnson
properties.What are the deployments that you are su: Glider transect across North Sea shelf edge
properties.What observations is the deployment tryi: Temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, chlorophyll fluorescence
properties.Please provide details of any sampling s: Lawnmower pattern at 200m depth intervals along three parallel transects

properties.Name: Ben Carter
properties.What are the deployments that you are su: Array of surface drifters tracking Gulf Stream extension
properties.What observations is the deployment tryi: Sea surface temperature, surface currents, atmospheric pressure
properties.Please provide details of any sampling s: Constellation of 12 drifters deployed at 50km spacing along a zonal line
properties.What notable limitations does your platf: No active propulsion; track entirely dependent on ambient currents. Battery life approximately 18 months.

properties.Name: Priya Nair
properties.What are the deployments that you are su: UAV survey of intertidal seagrass meadows
properties.What observations is the deployment tryi: Seagrass extent and density, sediment type, surface water turbidity
properties.Please provide details of any sampling s: Swath survey at 40m altitude with 70% overlap; ground truth points collected at 500m intervals
properties.What notable limitations does your platf: Maximum flight time of 25 minutes per battery; restricted to wind speeds below 15 knots; requires CAA authorisation for flights over 400ft
